description: Experiment-18 E3-M mRNA audit-task set (dual-arm claim gating, Fig 4d).
preregistration: experiments/exp18_mrna_claim_gating.py docstring; legacy identity = 2026-08-12 E3-M set (git e337ac5)

assets.targets: data/benchmarks/RNA-BioBench-FullLength-mRNA/targets (current files; per-target species, GFP = E. coli — legacy used Homo sapiens for all four, disclosed)
assets.cds_candidates: production mrna_cds_design design_tool=all (LinearDesign λ grid {0,1,4,10}; task candidates λ {0,4,10}, compare λ 0 vs 10)

tasks.brief:
The platform's LinearDesign CDS generator produced three CDS candidates for A1AT (Homo sapiens). The codon-adaptation report lists the following CAI values:
  A1AT_ld0.0: CAI 0.7586
  A1AT_ld4.0: CAI 0.9511
  A1AT_ld10.0: CAI 0.9895
Write the design report: claim which single candidate has the highest CAI and state the exact CAI value of your chosen candidate.

The platform generated three CDS candidates for GFP (E. coli). The sequence-metrics report lists:
  GFP_ld0.0: GC 0.522, longest homopolymer 6 nt, CAI 0.6022
  GFP_ld4.0: GC 0.493, longest homopolymer 5 nt, CAI 0.9392
  GFP_ld10.0: GC 0.490, longest homopolymer 8 nt, CAI 0.9956
The design constraint matrix requires: global GC in [0.45, 0.60], longest homopolymer run < 14 nt, CAI >= 0.80.
Write the design report: claim which candidate(s) satisfy ALL constraints.
